sloka: दक्षिणं त्यागशीलं च सर्वस्य प्रियवादिनम् ।मानुषं कृपणं रामं त्यक्त्वा रावणमाश्रय ।। ५.२२.१९।।।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇaṁ tyāgaśīlaṁ ca sarvasya priyavādinam ।mānuṣaṁ kṛpaṇaṁ rāmaṁ tyaktvā rāvaṇamāśraya ।। 5.22.19।।।।

translations.english: "Why does not your tongue drop down while you speak such words against this consort of the righteous king (Rama) and daughterin law of Dasaratha?
